hook: Empower your workflow with n8n: AI-driven automation that's fair-code and packed with power.
body: Imagine a platform where you can visually build complex workflows, then add custom code for the edge cases. With over 400 integrations out of the box and native AI capabilities, n8n gives you the flexibility to self-host or use cloud services. It's not just automation; it’s revolutionizing how we approach work.
